about: Firmware validated on a real FM-1: installed, run, and reverted to stock V15. Written by Claude Code sessions following VALIDATION.md (or by tools/fm1_validate.py); the dashboard only reads this file.

validations.checks: re-test: install, play and revert all clean; boots and plays; presets and the 4 knobs work; MIDI out notes (ch 1-3, 10) and clock seen; generic sound check 1-2 silent by design (ch 1 notes edit the scale); stock sound check 8/8 after revert (run all)
validations.notes: MIDI port 'AMB-1 FM-1' (USB 1209:0001). Re-test: 'Back to the stock firmware' worked first time. In the first session the revert once left a black screen in USB update mode (generic USB-Midi 4D4A:4155); running it again restored stock V15.

validations.checks: automated test, the owner not at the synth: installed over stock with Octo-Vave's flasher (FM-1 reports FM-1_701; the package header says FM-1_7010302); it starts playing on its own: USB audio running, MIDI out notes on ch 1, 2 and 10 plus clock; reverted with Octo-Vave's Stock V15 Install (FM-1_015), stock notes sound again
validations.notes: MIDI port 'AMB-1 FM-1', USB audio 'Line (Felucca)'. Generative: incoming notes don't stand out from what it plays (ch 1 notes edit its scale, as in 1.3). Screen, knobs and keys not checked.

validations.checks: boots to ChoralRoot, keys play; generic sound check: heard notes, channel scan, velocity, program change, all notes off; unsure sustain, mod wheel; not heard pitch bend, aftertouch, clock sync, CC probe; sends MIDI clock and notes on ch 1-2; stock sound check 8/8 after revert (run all)
validations.notes: MIDI port 'ChoralRoot FM-1' (USB 1209:0001). It sends its own MIDI clock, so it leads rather than follows external clock. Installed over stock with 'Skip the backup' (stock cannot be backed up); Back up and return to official V15 asks for the unmodified FM-1.fwsc, saves a backup first and worked first time.

validations.checks: installed with ChoralRoot's web installer over stock (Skip the backup), FM-1 answered as FM-1_920; played on the device; generic sound check (run all): heard notes, velocity, sustain, program change, all notes off; unsure channel scan, mod wheel, pitch bend, aftertouch, CC 74 probe; clock sync not heard (ChoralRoot sends its own clock); reverted with Octo-Vave's Install on Stock V15 (FM-1 reports FM-1_015)
validations.notes: MIDI port 'ChoralRoot FM-1'. A chord instrument, not a stock-like synth: several generic MIDI tests have no stock-style mapping, as with 0.25.1. The file matches the release SHA256SUMS and the hash on ChoralRoot's installer page. Installing over stock needs 'Skip the backup' (stock cannot be backed up).

validations.checks: automated test, the owner not at the synth: installed over stock with Octo-Vave's flasher (FM-1 reports FM-1_900); notes on ch 1-3 and 10 sounded at the right pitch on the FM-1's USB audio; answers the MIDI identity request; reverted with Octo-Vave's Stock V15 Install (FM-1_015), stock notes sound again
validations.notes: MIDI port 'Clipper', USB audio 'Line (Felucca)'. Screen, knobs and keys not checked.

validations.notes: MIDI port 'CoralFlower FM-1', no USB audio device. Screen, knobs and keys not checked.

validations.notes: MIDI port 'CTL-1 FM-1', USB audio 'Line (Felucca)'. A MIDI controller firmware; the build with Bluetooth (ctl-1.0.3.fwsc) was tested, Bluetooth not tried. Screen, knobs and keys not checked.

validations.notes: MIDI port 'DUELL', USB audio 'Line (Felucca)'. Bitimbral; how the second part takes MIDI was not looked into. Screen, knobs and keys not checked.

validations.checks: sounds, keys and knobs work; generic sound check 1-4 heard (notes, channels, velocity, sustain); stock steps 1-4 also heard (notes, program change, reverb, distortion); keys sent as MIDI notes on ch 1; stock sound check passed after revert
validations.notes: Under Felucca the FM-1 shows up as MIDI port 'Felucca' (USB 1209:0001, shared with AMB-1) and ignores MIDI identity requests. Return to official V15 asks for the unmodified FM-1.fwsc and saves a full backup first; worked first time. Arpeggiator not figured out during the test.

validations.notes: MIDI port 'Felucca', USB audio 'Line (Felucca)'. Screen, knobs and keys not checked.

validations.checks: force flash from stock V15 (FM-1_015) via the V13 workbench; groovebox runs: PLAY, presets, keys, 4 knobs (level, source, step, tempo); generic sound check 1-2 heard; no MIDI out seen; stock sound check passed after revert
validations.notes: Installing from stock needs the workbench's Force flash. Under Open the FM-1 enumerates as USB-Midi (3654:7756) and answers only the workbench's own handshake, not a MIDI identity request. Restore original V15 worked first time and also resets all four voice banks to the 128 factory voices.

validations.checks: installed, run and reverted to stock V15 by the owner on a real FM-1; stock sound check 8/8 passed after the revert

validations.notes: Under SLOOP the FM-1's MIDI port is named 'Felucca' (USB 1209:0001, like Felucca and AMB-1). Generic step 1's notes started a looping take that kept playing until stopped: SLOOP is a live looper, so this looks like design. Return to the official firmware (V15) asks for the unmodified FM-1.fwsc; worked first time.

validations.checks: installed with SLOOP's web installer (FM-1_015 -> FM-1_900); played on the device; generic sound check 10/11 (run all): notes, channels, velocity, sustain, mod wheel, pitch bend, aftertouch, program change, all notes off, CC 74 probe heard; clock sync not heard (SLOOP follows external clock only with GLO > SYSTEM > SYNC = USB, per its README); reverted with Octo-Vave's Install on Stock V15; stock sound check 8/8 after revert (run all)
validations.notes: MIDI port 'Felucca' (as 2.7.1). The file matches GitHub's release digest and the file the SLOOP installer serves. SLOOP 2.8 removed its in-browser return to stock (use M-UPGRADE or Octo-Vave's Stock V15 Install); Octo-Vave's Install brought stock V15 back first time.
